## Who he is

- Founder & owner, True North Services LLC (2026; grew from Oasis Exterior Cleaning, founded May 2023): 50+ clients and five-figure revenue in the first summer, +68% customer growth, wrote the company's ops framework and crew-training program.
- AI Intern, Screencastify (Jun–Aug 2026): mapped 7 workflows across 6 departments in 48 hours via one written diagnostic prompt; shipped 3 live automation fixes, including one cutting a 4–8 hr/week finance task to under 15 minutes.
- Elon University: Finance & Accounting dual major, minors in Entrepreneurship and Mandarin Chinese (near-fluent). Incoming president, AI & ET Club (2026–27).
- Self-directed investor since 2020; builds his own tools, including a live (private) portfolio tracker on this site.
